name: Just-In-Time Deactivated
description: Sent to the identity whose active Just-In-Time activation window has been deactivated. Notifies them that access has been removed and points them back to Launchpad to reactivate if needed.
subject: Your Just-In-Time access for ${entitlementName} has been deactivated
body:
Just-In-Time access deactivated

Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time activation window for ${entitlementName} has ended. Your temporary access has been removed.

Entitlement
${entitlementName}

Status
Just-In-Time access deactivated and removed

#if($activationUrl)

You can return to $__global.productName here to view details or reactivate this entitlement if needed.

#end

If you have any questions, please contact ${ownerName}.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
